messages.subject: Energy & Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Kenneth,

Your executive-search work across energy and industrial leadership is closely aligned with my background in regulated, asset-intensive environments. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, energy and infrastructure where responsible growth depends on strong institutional relationships and regulatory credibility. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
